title: Safe browsing in practice
intro: The padlock is not a safety promise. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Certificate page on the state portal
decisions.prompt: Look at the address bar. Safe, or a risk?

artifact.title: DövlətPortal: certificates
body: Online certificates. Sign in with your ID card or mobile signature.

decisions.explain: The domain is the official portal itself: dovletportal.az. No extra words or dashes.

decisions.title: Free document editor download
decisions.prompt: Look at the address bar. Safe, or a risk?
decisions.explain: A program file from a free download site is often malicious. Get software through tech support.

decisions.title: Bank sign-in under another domain
decisions.prompt: Look at the address bar. Safe, or a risk?
decisions.explain: The real domain is the last part: hesab-yoxla.info. The sahilbank.az in front is just bait.

decisions.title: Browser update from a website
decisions.prompt: Look at the address bar. Safe, or a risk?

artifact.title: Your browser is out of date
body: Download update.exe to keep browsing safely.

decisions.explain: Browser updates are not downloaded from websites. The browser updates itself.

decisions.title: Cards page on the bank's site
decisions.prompt: Look at the address bar. Safe, or a risk?

artifact.title: SahilBank: cards
body: Debit and credit cards. Compare cards and apply in a branch.

decisions.explain: The domain is sahilbank.az. The rest is just the page path.
